description: A table drawn on a sheet (id, number or name), as LayOut places a spreadsheet: rows of cells (text; numbers right-aligned), its top left corner at (paper mm from the sheet's top left), the first row as headings unless header is false, size the text height in mm (default 2.5). Cells can hold auto-text: {Sheet number}, {Sheet name}, {Date}, {Project}… Returns its id.

at.description: Paper mm from the top left

name: add_sheet_table
title: Add a table to a sheet
